findings.claim: MajorMUD has a dedicated background monster creation routine scheduled with RTKICK/_MY_RTKICK.
Monster update work is split into slow, medium, and fast update paths and can also be advanced from the user polling routine.
Monster generation checks room monster slots before generating; room occupancy/slot availability affects whether generation can proceed.
support: WCCMMUD.DLL.asm:_GENERATE_MONSTER offsets 400h/402h loop and 0Fh slot limit

findings.claim: Explicit monster timer evidence exists in _GENERATE_MONSTER using stored date/time fields plus _CALC_MINUTES_DIFFERENCE and a random jitter around byte offset 0ADh. Exact semantic name/record mapping is still not promoted to /Data.

Exact normal 15-minute global creature respawn interval remains user/domain knowledge and simulator hypothesis; this pass found scheduler architecture, but not a direct 15-minute constant mapped to normal creatures.
support: Absence of direct 15-minute proof in mapped routine-level evidence

approved_engine_docs: Monster updates are split into fast/medium/slow pipelines
Room monster slot occupancy gates generation
not_promoted: Exact cleanup interaction with monster timers
